actors.name: Developer
actors.description: Interacts with the desktop application to onboard, analyze the codebase, view 3D architecture diagrams, inspect code paths, chat with the AI assistant, export PDF reports/diagrams, manage authentication, and check AI usage balance.

actors.name: LLM Provider
actors.description: External language model API that generates contextual architecture summaries, enriched code insights, and answers chat queries with tool execution capability.

actors.name: Authentication Service
actors.description: External OAuth identity provider managing sign-in tokens and session verification.

useCases.name: Complete Onboarding
useCases.description: Guides new users through welcome screens, setup steps, and feature tour cards.

useCases.name: Analyze Codebase Workspace
useCases.description: Parses repository source code, framework structures, and Git history while displaying progress.

useCases.name: View Architecture Diagram
useCases.description: Renders interactive 3D dependency graphs, class diagrams, and data models within the desktop application.

useCases.name: Inspect Code Path
useCases.description: Drills down into code files, classes, relationship paths, and file changes in Git.

useCases.name: Enrich Analysis with AI
useCases.description: Generates natural language architectural summaries and context for analyzed components using LLMs.

useCases.name: Chat with AI Assistant
useCases.description: Allows developers to query the codebase and generated Spec in a chat panel and instruct the assistant to create or modify the Use Case Model or Data Model directly.

useCases.name: Export Diagrams and PDF Reports
useCases.description: Saves diagrams as image files or PDF software specification reports.

useCases.name: Manage User Authentication
useCases.description: Authenticates users via Web OAuth (Google or GitHub) and securely stores session info.

useCases.name: Check AI Token Balance
useCases.description: Queries and displays remaining AI credit balance for analysis from the top bar of the application.

useCases.name: View User Account Dashboard
useCases.description: Displays AI credit balance and usage history categorized by feature from the web dashboard.

overview: Kratai Desktop is an interactive desktop application for repository analysis, 3D architecture diagram generation, AI-powered codebase enrichment, and Software Requirements Specification (SRS) generation with an AI chat assistant and pay-as-you-go credit balance.
narrative: The desktop application serves as the primary user interface for developers. Developers onboard, analyze repository workspaces, view interactive 3D architecture diagrams, inspect code paths, chat with an AI assistant about the codebase and generated Spec, export diagrams or PDF reports, manage sign-in, and monitor usage history and AI credit balance, supported by external backend services including LLM providers processing AI queries and authentication services managing tokens and logins.

nfrs.name: AI Request Security
nfrs.text: External LLM API connections must process code snippets securely without unauthorized storage.

nfrs.name: Question Answering Scope
nfrs.text: The AI chat assistant will only answer questions about the current codebase and generated Spec, rejecting out-of-scope requests.

nfrs.name: Tool Loop Limit
nfrs.text: Each chat request runs through a predefined maximum number of tool execution turns to prevent infinite loops.

nfrs.name: Chat History Persistence
nfrs.text: Chat history is cached locally per workspace and restored automatically when reopening the app, limited to the 40 most recent messages.

nfrs.name: Token Storage Security
nfrs.text: Sign-in tokens are stored server-side only as salted hashes and validated on every authenticated request.

nfrs.name: Billing Markup Consistency
nfrs.text: All billed AI operations are charged at a fixed 2.5x provider cost margin and logged along with balance deductions.

nfrs.name: Telemetry Logging
nfrs.text: The system collects operational metrics and telemetry during codebase analysis sessions.
